<!-- pr-reviewer: 2e7f788568aad628017eee054aaec293bfe0c905 -->

Needs changes before merge - one pin (the trace's downstream refusal is explicit but not pinned).

Reviewed the head 2e7f78856 of side/path-kernel (base 25f3838db, 1 commit, merged clean - no conflicts, already up to date). Comments on the requested focus of this PR: the new medial-axis code and the trace chain region.

What looks good
- Provenance on every new file (geometry `delaunay.rs`, `medial.rs`, `side_offset.rs`; pathkernel `region_chain.rs`, `choice.rs`, `lead.rs`, `medial.rs`, `trace.rs`, `helix.rs`, `all.rs`). Published sources only (Blum 1967; Brandt & Algazi 1992; Bowyer/Watson 1981; Devillers et al. 2002; Foskey et al. 2003 / Attali & Montanvert 1996; Tiller & Hanson 1984; Choi & Park 1999; Ramer 1972 / Douglas & Peucker 1973; Held 1991; our own design records). Not a port of the old spines.
- Degenerate input refused by name, never crashed or hung: non-positive/NaN tolerance or angle refused (`medial.rs`), empty region refused, >200,000 boundary samples refused, Delaunay returns Ok([]) for <3 points and errors on non-finite points (never panics), side_offset refuses <2 points, non-finite points or distance, zero distance and a no-length path, `Chain::closed`/`Chain::open`/`Selection` validation refuses empty/collinear/crossing chains, and a neck-touching area is pinned to produce an axis without crash (`geo2d::medial::tests`).
- The new medial axis is sorted by point set (input order and start vertex never affect it - pinned in geometry and pathkernel), theta-pruned, RDP-simplified, and spur-count is named in a note.
- Follow-up #4236: the record (decision 4, `docs/decisions/4176-kernel-guides-medial-trace-helix.md`) names the exact ordering - the entry stage refuses a chain region (`NOT_PLANAR`, `entry/room.rs:28-29`), the law kit reads the tool from `planar()` (`tests/laws/kit.rs:169-178`), so a trace cannot run through all stages yet - and #4236 exists to cover it.

Results (local, this worktree; runner not applicable - side-branch base). Independent confirmation on the touched crates (per the author's gate: batch 1223 steps, 0 failed, 88.9 min; light 7/7, both on 2e7f78856, trusted as reported - not re-run):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --lib`: 94 passed (incl. medial, delaunay, side_offset)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --test laws`: 134 passed (incl. guide_medial, guide_trace, guide_helix, guide_laws)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --lib`: 4 passed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels kernel_`: 22 passed (incl. kernel_guides: trace, medial, circle rings, helix against the #4153 goldens)
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-pathkernel -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Targeted tests: example catalog untouched by this diff (no post/toolpath change). The full heavy lanes are not run for a P2 PR under the safety floor (no `P1`); the light lane is taken as the author's 7/7 on this head, not re-run.

Requested before merge
1. Pin the trace chain region's downstream refusal. The entry stage refuses a non-planar region by name (`NOT_PLANAR`, `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/stage.rs:25` via `entry/room.rs:29`) and the law kit reads the tool from `planar()` (`crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/kit.rs:170`), but no test pins either refusal on a chain region: a silent behavior change (entry begins to accept a chain region, or the kit starts to accept one, without the follow-up being updated) would pass. Add one test, e.g. in `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/guide_trace.rs` (next to `each_refusal_of_the_trace_is_named`), asserting `EntryStage` refuses a chain region with `NOT_PLANAR`. Small addition; do not change the downstream code.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The medial planner guards a sample cap (`MEDIAL_TOO_FINE`) but the geometry layer's own cap is a backstop; both fire, naming their reason. Good.
- The trace L1-L4 law checks are read on the guide and the stand-in order stage (`guide_trace.rs`), because the kit's stages plan an area. That is the documented ordering (decision 4), not a shortcut.
- The new `medial_tests.rs` and `kernel_guides.rs` join the geometry lib suite and the `pass_start_levels` directory suite - good placement.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ebc9663503f6dd87947ac6d5d5b0d6ced44ef08d -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge - the one finding of the last review (the trace chain region's downstream refusal was unpinned) is fixed and verified on this head.

Reviewed the head ebc966350 of side/path-kernel (base 25f3838db, unchanged since the last review; trial merge clean - the base is an ancestor of the head, no conflicts). This is a re-review of the one-commit fix on 2e7f78856: the diff 2e7f78856..ebc966350 is only `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/guide_trace.rs` (+59 lines). No stage logic changed.

What looks good
- The fix is one table test, `guide_trace::each_later_stage_refuses_the_chain_region_of_a_trace_by_name`, and it is one test for the whole class (every later stage that reads the region refuses by its named reason), not a per-stage patch.
- The test pins the right stages and the right reasons. Every stage on this branch that reads a kernel region: `EntryStage::entry` and `EntryStage::exit` (real code, refusing `entry::NOT_PLANAR` via `entry/room.rs:29` and `entry/exit.rs:111`), the law kit `planar` (`tests/laws/kit.rs:169` - `kit::NOT_PLANAR`) and the law kit `run` (same refusal at its region read, `kit.rs:178`). The order, load and link stages have only a trait on this branch (no planner; `load.rs`, `link.rs`, `order.rs`), so nothing to pin there - that is #4236.
- The test fails loudly. It runs every leg inside `catch_unwind`: a panic is a failure of that leg, an accepted plan is a failure (`accepts the chain region of a trace`), and a refusal is matched against the expected reason string. It does not assert a pass.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/4176-kernel-guides-medial-trace-helix.md` is accurate on this head: decision 4 names the entry stage's `NOT_PLANAR` refusal and the kit's `planar()` tool-read, and the guide choices moved to `guide/choice.rs` with the same public paths by re-export (`guide.rs` is 255 lines, under the ~400-line rule). No AIR-constant issue in this PR's files (that is a different PR, #4234).

Results (local, this worktree .claude/worktrees/cc-pr4244-review, sccache, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --lib`: 94 passed (medial, delaunay, side_offset)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --test laws`: 135 passed (incl. guide_trace, guide_medial, guide_helix, guide_laws; the new test runs by name: `1 passed`)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --lib`: 4 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-pathkernel --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- The full batch was green on 2e7f78856 (1223 steps, 0 failed, 88.9 min) per the author's report and the previous review; the new head adds one test file, so it is not re-run here. The light lane (7 steps, 0 failed) was green on 2e7f78856 per the same report; not re-run for the same reason.

Targeted tests
- No post or toolpath change - the example catalog is not run.
- The new test is the pinning test for this finding - run by name (1 passed).
- P2 PR, no heavy step is owed (not P1).

Requested before merge
- Nothing.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The `kit::run` leg refuses at its region read, so the stand-in order, load, link and entry planners in its table are never reached on this region. That is expected today (the kit plans an area) and is the documented ordering of decision 4; it will change with #4236, and the test comment says so.
- The `guide: Box::new(TracePlanner)` in the planner set is unused by the table (the kit refuses before the guide stage). Harmless; kept for the day #4236 lands.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
